references.text: Psalm 23:5 speaks of anointing with oil, which can be seen as a connection to the act of anointing Jesus' body with myrrh in preparation for his burial.
Exodus 30:12 mentions the use of anointing oil for holy purposes, reflecting the sacred act of anointing Jesus' body.
John 12:3 describes Mary anointing Jesus' feet with nardus oil, an action similar to that described in Matthew 26:12.
John 19:39-40 tells how Nicodemus and Joseph of Arimathea prepared Jesus' body for burial, including the use of myrrh, which directly relates to the preparation mentioned in Matthew 26:12.
